name: Rhauderfehn (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rhauderfehn (a yellow anchor with wings and a serpent on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Rhauderfehn; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Rhauderfehn arms — winged anchor on blue
